extension.summary: Scan your libraries for new content
Busca contenido nuevo en tus bibliotecas
extension.description: Triggers the video and/or music library scan, the same as Kodi's "Update library on startup" option. Only sources with a content type (scraper) set are scanned. When finished, a summary shows how many items were added.[CR][CR]Run it from Add-ons > Program add-ons, or add it to your favourites to launch it from the home screen.[CR][CR]Developed by jairamrb.com

Lanza el escaneo de la biblioteca de vídeo y/o música, igual que la opción "Buscar nuevo contenido al iniciar" de Kodi. Solo se escanean las fuentes que tienen un tipo de contenido (scraper) asignado. Al terminar muestra un resumen con lo que se ha añadido.[CR][CR]Ejecútalo desde Add-ons > Complementos de programa, o añádelo a tus favoritos para lanzarlo desde la pantalla de inicio.[CR][CR]Desarrollado por jairamrb.com
extension.news:
Version 1.1.0 - Taller summary window, with a countdown when it closes by itself - New settings: close the summary automatically, and after how many seconds (15 by default). Pressing up or down stops the countdown - The summary shows every library: music videos and artists are counted too, and a library that was not scanned says why - Pictures: Kodi has no picture library, so the add-on counts the files in the picture sources and shows how many are new since the last run - Music and pictures are off by default - New "About" section in the settings, with a button to look for new content right away - Launch options: report=dialog|notification|none and library=video|music|all - Other add-ons and JSON-RPC clients are notified when the scan starts and finishes, with the new items found - A second launch while a scan is running no longer starts another one
Version 1.0.0 - Manual video and music library scan - Summary with the new content found - English and Spanish translations
